title: WorkflowPlaybook
description: DAG of capability invocations against inventory targets.

apiVersion.description: API version for the AIWG Flows metalanguage (aiwg-utils). `flow.aiwg.io/v1` is the forward Flows spelling (#1536); `workflow.aiwg.io/v1` remains accepted for back-compat.

kind.description: Resource kind. `FlowPlaybook` is the forward Flows name (#1536); `WorkflowPlaybook` remains accepted for back-compat.

spec.description: Playbook specification defining execution steps, optionally over inventory targets.

inventory.description: Reference to an OpsInventory resource name. Optional (#1539): host-ops Flows iterate an inventory; SDLC/project Flows act on a single project context and omit this.

vars.description: Playbook-level variables available to all steps.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps forming the execution DAG.

status.description: Runtime status (populated by the executor, not authored).

lastApplied.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last execution.

conditions.description: Status conditions from the last execution.

labels.description: Key-value labels for filtering and selection.

step.description: A single step in the playbook DAG.

not.description: A step must not set both `capability` and `fanout` (#1547).

id.description: Unique step identifier within this playbook.

capability.description: Reference to an OpsCapability resource name.

fanout.description: Agentic step (#1547): dispatch a panel of executor capabilities, then synthesize one result. The declarative spelling of the multi-agent documentation pattern (Primary → Parallel Reviewers → Synthesizer). Mutually exclusive with `capability`. Maps onto the Workflow-tool parallel()/pipeline() + aggregation (adr-workflow-routing.md); agents may target different stack:<name> executors for a cross-stack Mission (#1546).

strategy.description: How the panel runs: `parallel` (independent panel, default) or `pipeline` (chained, each agent sees the prior output).

agents.description: Capability references forming the panel — each dispatched to its executor agent.

synthesize.description: Capability reference that draws one conclusion from the panel outputs; its result is the step's output for downstream depends_on consumers.

kind.description: Inline step kind (e.g., gate, extension) when not referencing a capability.

description.description: Human-readable step description. Required in practice for inline gate steps (kind: gate) — the executor surfaces this text to the human at the pause point (see executor contract step 5).

depends_on.description: Step IDs that must complete before this step runs.

from.description: Reference to a previous step output (e.g., 'step-id.output-name').

outputs.description: Outputs captured from this step for downstream use.

spec.description: Inline spec when using kind instead of capability reference.
